name: zfmv_script_update_at_time
description: zFMV_Script::UpdateAtTime samples timeGetTime, converts milliseconds to seconds with the original 0.001f constant shape, and forwards to zFMV_Script::Update.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison for zfmv_script_time_wrappers now matches 0x4630e0 with zero unmasked function-byte mismatches, and the g_zFMV_ScriptTimeGetTimeToSecondsScale float data symbol at 0x4d2580 has zero unmasked data-byte mismatches.
Source dependencies are accepted through zFMV_Script::Update, which is now tier B/source-faithful with no authored globals touched.
